It's a complex comparison where the level of services provided seems to correlate with tax burden.

text: I believe the United States has a high tax rate but not the highest among the Western countries. However, the taxes collected have not be effectively utilized to offer quality services to the citizens in comparison to what is offered in other top Western countries
